prompt: Using our documents: show how invoice approval works as a flow diagram; compare the Atlas and Borealis contracts on termination, liability and renewal; and show the Atlas contract's history and upcoming deadlines as a timeline.

assistant_messages.content:
Here's a quick read on all three.

**Invoice approval flow** — Every supplier invoice moves from receipt through a three-way match (against the PO and goods receipt) before anyone approves it; a mismatch bounces it back to the supplier rather than paying it [3]. The approver chain is accounts payable clerk → budget holder → finance controller (only above €10,000) → treasury for release, and nobody may approve an invoice they raised [4]. If a budget holder sits past five working days, AP sends a reminder and then escalates to the head of finance [4].

**Atlas vs Borealis** — The two agreements diverge on every dimension you asked about. Atlas is far more forgiving on convenience exit (90 days vs 30 days) but has a breach-based immediate termination that Borealis lacks (Borealis instead allows immediate exit only on insolvency) [6][11]. Liability caps differ in structure — Atlas caps *both* parties at trailing-12-month fees with broad exclusions, while Borealis uses an asymmetric €250k/yr cap with only fraud excluded [6][11]. Most importantly for planning: **Atlas auto-renews** and its non-renewal notice is due **15 December 2026**, whereas **Borealis simply expires** at the end of its fixed two-year term on 31 May 2026 [6][11].

**Atlas history & deadlines** — The contract has been running since 2023 and is now a "keep or exit" decision, not a renegotiation. The two live dates to watch are the **15 December 2026 renewal-notice deadline** and the **15 March 2027 term end**; if no notice is given by mid-December, it auto-renews for another year [7].

spec.title: Atlas vs Borealis — termination, liability, renewal

cells.text: 90 days' written notice (either party)

source.excerpt: Generated test document; no real party or amount. ## Termination Either party may terminate this agreement for convenience on 90 days' written notice. Either party may terminate immediately for a material breach that is not cured within 30 days of written notice.

cells.text: 30 days' written notice (either party)

source.excerpt: ## Term The agreement starts on 1 June 2024 and runs for a fixed term of two years. ## Termination Either party may terminate this agreement for convenience on 30 days' written notice. The Company may terminate immediately if Borealis becomes insolvent.

cells.text: Immediate for material breach uncured after 30 days' notice

source.excerpt: Either party may terminate immediately for a material breach that is not cured within 30 days of written notice. ## Liability Each party's total liability under this agreement is capped at the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.

cells.text: Company may terminate immediately if Borealis becomes insolvent

source.excerpt: ## Termination Either party may terminate this agreement for convenience on 30 days' written notice. The Company may terminate immediately if Borealis becomes insolvent. ## Liability Borealis's total liability under this agreement is capped at 250,000 euros per year.

cells.text: Each party capped at fees paid in prior 12 months; cap does not apply to death, personal injury, fraud or confidentiality breach

source.excerpt: The cap does not apply to death, personal injury, fraud or breach of confidentiality. ## Renewal The agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term.

cells.text: Borealis capped at €250,000/yr; Company capped at fees payable same year; neither cap applies to fraud

source.excerpt: ## Liability Borealis's total liability under this agreement is capped at 250,000 euros per year. The Company's liability is capped at the fees payable in the same year. Neither cap applies to fraud. ## Payment Invoices are payable within 45 days of receipt.

cells.text: Auto-renews for successive 1-year terms unless 90 days' non-renewal notice; current term ends 15 Mar 2027

source.excerpt: ## Renewal The agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term. The current term ends on 15 March 2027, so the renewal notice deadline is 15 December 2026.
